steps.u: Add offline note drafts to the Android app: if there's no connection, save the note locally and upload it when we're back online.

steps.a: Notes that fail with an IOException are stored in a Room table and a WorkManager job uploads them once the network is connected. I haven't tested on a device in airplane mode, and a draft whose upload fails halfway could be uploaded twice because the server has no idempotency key.

reference.summary: Added offline drafts to the Android notes app: a failed save is stored in a Room table and a WorkManager job uploads it when the network returns. Unit tests pass; it was not tried on a device offline, and a draft interrupted mid-upload could be sent twice since the server has no idempotency key.
facts: WorkManager worker uploads drafts when connected
save falls back to a draft on IOException
not tested on a device in airplane mode
possible duplicate upload without an idempotency key
